mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.`xmfl` = '市级项目' THEN l.`id` END) AS cityCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.`xmfl` = '区级项目' THEN l.`id` END) AS districtCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.`xmfl` IN ('市级项目', '区级项目') THEN l.`id` END) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.`ptxmmc` IS NOT NULL AND f.`ptxmmc` NOT LIKE '%不涉及%' AND f.`ptxmmc` != '引河里北道、富彩道' THEN f.`ptxmmc` END) AS roadCount FROM `t_land` l LEFT JOIN `xj_kjkfb_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` AND COALESCE(f.`delFlag`, '0') = '0' WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0

SELECT l.`xmfl` AS projectType, l.`xzqh` AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.`id`) AS value, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.`ptxmmc` IS NOT NULL AND f.`ptxmmc` NOT LIKE '%不涉及%' AND f.`ptxmmc` != '引河里北道、富彩道' THEN f.`ptxmmc` END) AS roadCount FROM `t_land` l LEFT JOIN `xj_kjkfb_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` AND COALESCE(f.`delFlag`, '0') = '0' WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` IN ('市级项目', '区级项目') AND l.`xzqh` IS NOT NULL AND l.`xzqh` != '' GROUP BY l.`xmfl`, l.`xzqh` ORDER BY value DESC, l.`xzqh`
